title: Viva Engage: richer shared message previews and a full conversation dialog
summary: The rollout, user experience, licensing background and undocumented switch are consistent with Microsoft's notice and the documentation checked. Remove the unsupported assurance that nothing runs on a user's behalf, and make the summary include Microsoft's recommendation to update training and support materials.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The display update reaches the affected users on rollout without an administrator enabling it.
claims.quote: Shared messages will display more of the original content, including formatted text, images, videos, and attachments. No changes to existing sharing workflows are required.

claims.claim: The notice requires no changes to existing sharing workflows and prescribes no configuration for the update.
claims.quote: No changes to existing sharing workflows are required. We recommend informing users about the improved shared message experience and updating any existing training or support materials that demonstrate how shared messages appear in Viva Engage.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends informing users, summarised as asking administrators only to tell users.
claims.quote: We recommend informing users about the improved shared message experience and updating any existing training or support materials that demonstrate how shared messages appear in Viva Engage.
claims.fix: Replace the summary's final sentence with 'Users get it automatically; Microsoft recommends informing users and updating training or support materials.' The notice recommends both actions rather than asking administrators only to tell users.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The notice does not explain previews for recipients unable to view the original post.
claims.quote: Searched: the complete supplied MC1539003 text for original-post access, permissions, private communities and recipient restrictions; it describes content previews, edits and the dialog but gives no such explanation.

claims.claim: The notice identifies display and navigation changes rather than a new sign-in, role or permission.
claims.quote: Searched: the complete supplied MC1539003 text for sign-in, roles and permissions; its What will happen section describes previews, the dialog, user interactions and edits, with no new identity requirement.

claims.claim: Nothing runs on a user's behalf in the improved shared message experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage shared messages conversation dialog automatic autonomous actions acting on behalf of users. Read MC1539003 and Learn search excerpts for Engage integrations and Cowork; none states this assurance for shared message previews.
claims.fix: Remove '; nothing runs on a user's behalf' from the Autonomy & actions bullet. The notice documents users reacting, replying and sharing, but does not establish the broader negative assurance.

claims.claim: Reacting and replying to posts are capabilities users already have in Viva Engage feeds.
claims.quote: This setting controls who has a storyline feed on their user profile and who can create new storyline posts. It doesn't restrict who can view, react, or reply to storyline posts made by others.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/engage/eac-storyline to sources for the existing feed reaction and reply capabilities.
